reasons: Aggregation differs: the Datadog query is avg:postgresql.rows_inserted{$scope} with no group-by, which averages across the reporting series. The candidate uses sum(), which totals them. The result is a different number, not just a scale difference.

Quantity is the same (rows inserted, via the monotonic sum postgresql.tup_inserted). The rate() wrapping matches the '(per sec)' widget title, assuming the Datadog values are per-second rates, which the query alone does not confirm.
Grouping matches (no by-clause on either side) and the template variable $scope has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct.
Outcome is correct: no function is involved, so translating is allowed. The aggregation should be avg(rate(...)) over the same selector, not sum(...).
